 Drishyam 3 yet again witnessed a post-Diwali jump of 150% at the box office. Will it hit the final milestone that stands very close?

 Drishyam 3 yet again witnessed a post-Diwali jump of 150% at the box office. Will it hit the final milestone that stands very close?
 By Trishha Gaur - November 10, 2026 | 3:13 PM IST 
 Join Us 
 Share 
 Facebook 
 Twitter 
 WhatsApp 
 Email 
 Copy Copied 
 Drishyam 3 Box Office: Stands Very Close To The Final Milestone! (Photo Credit: Star Studio18) 
 The box office number-room for Ajay Devgn’s thriller masterpiece Drishyam 3: The Conclusion is refusing to fade away! Even in its 6th week (Day 39) and facing huge screen competition from Ramayana, the Abhishek Pathak-directed film witnessed a dhamakedaar 150% jump on its 6th Monday.
 Accumulating a cumulative India Net Collection of 380.07 crore in 39 days, the crime thriller threequel, is currently holding its firm spot as the 4th most profitable Hindi film of 2026, standing right behind Hanuman Ansh, Dhurandhar 2, and Awarapan 2.
 Less Than 2 Crore Away From Final Milestone 
 Beating Emraan Hashmi ‘s Awarapan 2 is now sitting right within arm’s reach! Emraan Hashmi’s Awarapan 2 concluded its theatrical run with a lifetime collection of 156.12 crore on a budget of 45.00 crore , generating 111.12 crore in net profits and a staggering 246.90% Return on Investment.
 Trending 
 Ramayana Worldwide Box Office: Crosses 500 Crore Globally, Ranbir Kapoor, Yash’s Biggie Hits 5 Major Records On The Opening Weekend! 
 Ramayana Box Office Record: Creates History With Biggest Hourly BMS Sales: Beats Dhurandhar 2 & Pushpa 2 To Hit The Biggest Milestone!
 Drishyam 3’s 150% Jump Brings Hope! 
 On the 6th Monday, Drishyam 3 earned almost 20 lakh , as compared to the previous day’s 8 lakh . This 150% jump at the box office is hinting at the final achievable milestone for the film – claiming the spot for the 3rd most-profitable Hindi film of 2026.
 To match that exact 246.90% ROI benchmark set by Emraan Hashmi’s Awarapan 2 , Drishyam 3 needs to touch a total domestic net collection of 381.59 crore . With its current tally standing at 380.07 crore, the film is just 1.52 crore away from dethroning Awarapan 2 and officially becoming the 3rd Most Profitable Hindi Film of 2026!
 With a 150% 6th Monday surge taking its global footprint past 593 crore gross, Ajay Devgn’s edge-of-the-seat thriller has delivered a theatrical run for the history books. Collecting just 1.52 crore more over the post-Diwali week will officially crown Drishyam 3 as the 3rd Most Profitable Hindi Film of 2026!
 Drishyam 3 Box Office Summary 
 Check out the breakdown of the film at the box office after 39 days.
 India Net Collection: 380.07 crore 
 India Gross Collection: 448.53 crore 
 Budget: 110 crore 
 Profit: 270.07 crore 
 ROI%: 245.52% 
 Overseas Gross Collection: 144.89 crore 
 Worldwide Gross Collection: 593.42 crore
